title: 039 NNPredict -- sizer stage: the R7-selected model's predicted move as a width-book sizer (cs_aro pattern)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); halves are the persistence test (constitution gate 2). Nothing is adopted by this stage; it selects the model the framework and sizer stages use.
screen: research/nnpredict/screen.py on the 412 early width-book trades (research.new_inputs.trades), score = predict_gain ('up') and -predict_gain ('flip'); no training, no backtest, late half blind
screen_decision: pass if either direction passes; the passing direction (the larger gap_share50 if both) is the sizer's score sign
sizer_threshold: per fold, the 0.5 agree-share threshold of the (signed) score at width-book run starts on the training validation tail (research/nnpredict/pick.py)
alone: judge_one(sizer_arm, sizer_control) must PASS; judge_one vs w_aro and cs_aro reported
seed_rule: a PASS with whole-period gain < 1 pp needs a seed-2 rerun before any adoption
fallback: screen fails in both directions -> no sizer backtest; recorded as the stage result
